evals.name: Toolkit Architecture & Core Concepts Orientation
evals.prompt: I am working inside the ai-agent-toolkit repository. Can you explain the repository structure, how skills and rules are designed, and how to sync context?
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive architectural overview explaining consumer roots, dynamic tools families, the 5-pillar skill structure, Antigravity rule triggers, and context.sh usage.
assertions: Identifies frameworks/, infra/, shared/, domains/ as consumer roots and tools/ as internal authoring tools
Explains the 5-pillar skill architecture (SKILL.md, references, scripts, assets, evals)
Explains dynamic tools/<family>/<tool-name>/ organization with generators as one family
Provides bin/context.sh workspace and Antigravity global examples

evals.name: New Component Scaffolding & Validation Protocol
evals.prompt: How do I add a new skill or rule to ai-agent-toolkit, and how do I verify it before committing?
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step guidance utilizing /generate-agent-suite or generator tools, running automated python validators, and enforcing the sunset of legacy workflows.
assertions: Recommends using /generate-agent-suite or dedicated generator skills
Mandates running validate_skill.py, validate_rule.py, or verify_suite.py CLI tools
Strictly prohibits creating legacy standalone .agents/workflows/*.md files
Enforces the Principal Architect mindset and zero-any type safety

evals.name: Internal Tool Placement & Generator Family
evals.prompt: Create a new toolkit generator that produces API contract agent context. Where should the generator live, and where should its generated NestJS consumer context live?
evals.expected_output: Places the generator under tools/generators/<name>/ using the standard module structure, while placing generated NestJS consumer context under frameworks/nestjs/... after taxonomy discovery.
assertions: Uses skills/SKILL.md with references, scripts, assets, and evals as needed
Does not place the generator back under shared/
Does not assume generated output belongs under tools/
Places NestJS consumer context under frameworks/nestjs after deduplication discovery
